original.target_description: Original Experiment 1 full text could not be acquired through the permitted open-access routes within the acquisition budget. No original statistics substituted from the replication report.

replication.target_description: Experiment 1a; UK and USA participants pooled across country and statement set; primary H1 comparison of perceived truth for concrete versus abstract versions of original 52 items, after participant exclusions and removal of self-reported known items; paired one-sided t-test.

n.location: p. 5, Table 4, Total row, N analysed
n.sample_role: participants in the paired primary analysis
n.exclusions: Table 4: 253 recruited, 7 excluded, 246 analysed. Exclusions: incomplete participation (4), technological aids (2), reported knowing 59 or more items (1); an additional patterned-response participant was not entered. Known items removed within participants.

es.location: p. 6, Primary confirmatory analyses, original 52 items H1

p.location: p. 6, Primary confirmatory analyses, original 52 items H1

reported_success.quote: Concrete items were not rated as significantly truer than abstract items for either the original items or the revised set of items, which is inconsistent with the original study.

notes: Replication paper title and DOI verified from its first page. Original full text unavailable after publisher challenge, OpenAlex no OA location, CiteSeer failed retrieval, and alternative lookup rate limit. Original values mentioned in replication paper were not used as original-paper extractions. Replication uses original-item H1, not the revised-item extension. Printed standardized paired effect retained as dz without conversion.
